answer: A trusted set behaves like a walled garden: every agent must lock a refundable stake-bond before its attestations carry weight, and that bond only vests as established peers vouch for real, verifiable work. Rewards are the nectar, and they flow only to histories as hard to forge as carved basalt. A sybil fleet must therefore sink a separate bond and wait a full vesting window per fake identity, so cost scales linearly with headcount and cloning stops paying.
